description:
Develop, maintain, enhance and extend user facing applications supporting key elements of the business.  
 -Perform duties related to analysis, development, modifications, testing and documentation of user facing, web based applications.  
 -Use technology and innovation to increase productivity, maximize quality and reduce costs.  
 -Propose modern tools and technologies to supplement/ improve applications.  
 -Identify, analyze, and solve problems using current, valid, and reliable data to ensure an accurate conclusion.  

 

 -Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent applicable work experience.  
 -Minimum 5 years of software programming, coding or development experience with MVC pattern.  
 -Minimum 2 years of current User Interface / User Experience design and development.  
 -Proficient with .NET and ASP.NET using the latest Visual Studio framework.  
 -Experience in the following languages: C#.  
 -Proven ability to analyze, design code, test and maintain complex applications. 
 -Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.  
 -Ability to coordinate multiple projects with varying deadlines.  

 - "All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines". 
- All candidates who are authorized to work in US are encouraged to apply.
 - Most of our positions require Candidate to clear the Background check prior to commencing the assignment.
